needsBespoke.why: All damage-relevant mechanics (onhit second shot, stacking proc damage, boomerang two-pass hit, attack-speed-scaled swing shots, crit interactions, channel+volley ultimate) map onto the closed primitive list; the terrain-dependent parts of E are handled via the positional-assumption primitive rather than needing new logic, though the assumption itself is flagged as unsettled.

unsettled.question: Heroic Swing's first cast requires embedding a hook in terrain to function at all, but the simulated dummy fight has no terrain, allies, or minions. Can Akshan use E in this fight, and if so how?
options: Assume a wall is always available near the target, so E can be cast fully (hook attaches, swing engages, third cast fires) as normal
Treat E as uncastable in this arena and exclude it from the rotation entirely
Allow only the parts of E that don't require terrain (e.g. treat it as unusable) or substitute a fixed number of shots as a stand-in
quotes: '''Akshan''' fires a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first [[terrain]] hit, and enters {{tt|preparation|See notes}} for up to {{fd|2.125}} seconds.

options: Assume the return pass always re-hits the dummy, so each Q cast deals two full damage instances (outgoing + return)
Assume only the outgoing throw hits and the return misses (no second target in its path back), so each Q cast deals one damage instance
Model it probabilistically or via an assumed engagement distance that sometimes yields both hits

Assume the swing persists for its full theoretical duration (bounded only by the wall/anchor lifetime) for maximum shot count

unsettled.question: Comeuppance's per-bullet crit bonus is written in the bin as a continuous function of critChance (DamagePerBulletWithCrit scales by CritDamageMod x critChance x (critDamage-1)) rather than a per-bullet random crit roll. Should the simulator apply this as a deterministic partial bonus to every bullet, or roll each bullet for an independent binary crit?
options: Apply the bin's formula deterministically to every bullet (expected-value style, no variance)
Roll each bullet independently for a full crit based on crit chance, with no damage on non-crit bullets beyond base
Treat them as equivalent in expectation and use whichever the simulator's engine already does for other champions' similar formulas

proposal: Open by auto-attacking the dummy immediately to start building Dirty Fighting stacks and triggering the passive's delayed second shot on every attack.
Cast Avengerang (Q) as soon as possible and again on cooldown throughout the fight, since it is Akshan's highest-uptime source of bonus AD-scaled physical damage.

If E is deemed castable in this arena (see terrain unsettled question), fire Heroic Swing's first cast toward the assumed nearby terrain, immediately follow with the second cast to begin the repeating 0.2s shots at the dummy, and use the third cast promptly to land the final shot and free up the ability for its next cooldown.
Continue weaving basic attacks between Q and E casts at every opportunity so the on-hit second shot and Dirty Fighting stacks are never wasted.

Cast Comeuppance (R) once available; channel to its full 2.5s duration before recasting so all available bullets (5-7 by rank) are stored and fired together at the dummy for maximum missing-health-scaled burst, since its long cooldown likely allows only one use in the 15s window.
Keep attacking and recasting Q/E on cooldown for the remainder of the 15 seconds; do not use W, since it deals no damage and only offers mobility/utility that the fight rules say to ignore.
